text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the appointed candidate are women, making it virtually impossible to argue that your sex played a role in the decision. Pointing to the panel's all-female makeup would lack legal merit, appear unfounded, and risk damaging your professional reputation.

Instead, keep your focus entirely on qualification criteria and administrative procedure. You possess dedicated leadership credentials—a relevant master's degree and five years of deputy principal experience—compared to the successful applicant's classroom-heavy background. Follow up politely on your pending request for written feedback, centering your inquiry strictly on how qualifications, leadership track records, and interview evaluations were weighed against the stated selection criteria.
